mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over a 3-month window signals an economic downturn that increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 5.5% in the past 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% over the past month indicates a severe economic contraction, causing risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 5.5% in the past month, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million dollars (the August 2008 level) indicates weakening consumer spending, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 370000, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as high unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth potential.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is above 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 950,000 units (the July 2008 level) indicates a worsening housing market, which increases financial sector risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 950, the 5-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) below 950,000 units signals a broad-based consumer and housing market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 370000 and HOUST < 950, the 20-day forward returns are positive.
